English: A lever instead of a trigger... not bad.

Korean: 오늘 운은 저쪽 기계에 좀 붙어있네... 아마도...
English: Today's luck seems to be sticking to that machine over there... probably...
The lever turned but the wallet stayed the same.
I will call it tuition for one of life's lessons.
Not bad. At least I covered the drinking money.

Korean: 제법인데. 오늘은 좋은 걸 마실 수 있겠어.
English: Not bad at all. I can drink something better tonight.

Korean: 잭팟이라. 오늘 밤은 운명도 내 잔에 술을 따르는군.
English: Jackpot. Tonight even fate is pouring a drink into my glass.

Korean: 하아암... 흐름이 죽었네. 이 판은 접는 게 맞아...
English: Yaaawn... The flow is dead. This is a hand you fold...

Korean: 나쁘지 않아... 손해 안 봤으면 이긴 판이야...
English: Not bad... If you did not lose then it counts as a win...

Korean: 음냐... 역시 일하지 않고 버는 돈이 제일 달콤해...
English: Mnya... Money earned without working really is the sweetest...

Korean: 잭팟... 행운의 여신이 네 편인가 보네...
English: Jackpot... Looks like Lady Luck is on your side...
